name: jm-live-skip
description: The worked example, transcribed from a real run. Pairs with flows/jm-live-skip.json: the flow drives, this judges. Note the division it makes — the machine proves the run REACHED each moment and that nothing broke on the way, and every claim about what a human would then SEE (or read in a server log) is handed over as UNJUDGEABLE with the timestamp to aim at. That division is the point: the loop can tell you the thing was exercised, which is the half that used to be assumed.

items.falsifiedBy: no `submitted` chapter — the form never went through, so nothing downstream means anything

items.claim: GUARD — the mid-show skip window opened and the client aborted
items.falsifiedBy: no `SKIPPED` chapter. The run played to the end instead, so the abort path was never taken and every teardown claim below is untested rather than false

items.claim: GUARD — the verdict page rendered after the skip
items.falsifiedBy: no `verdict page rendered` chapter — the skip lost the ruling instead of revealing it, which would be a worse bug than the one under test

items.claim: No uncaught exceptions or unhandled rejections during the run
items.falsifiedBy: any page error. Note this is the channel agent-browser's own `errors` cannot see — it comes from the injected hook

items.claim: No console errors during the run
items.falsifiedBy: any console error. Weigh it, do not reflex-fail: plenty of pages log errors that do not matter
any 4xx/5xx or status-0 request. Incomplete requests are reported separately and are NOT failures — a request still in flight at the last sample is normal

items.claim: after() held the invocation open through the abort, and the VM came down
items.falsifiedBy: no `sandbox.live_teardown` line in the run's logs (after() did not hold), or the line present with stopped:false (it held but the VM survived)

items.claim: The gatekeeper's egress meter reached the host
items.falsifiedBy: cost.compute carrying egress_measured:false — the meter never reported and the totals remain a floor

items.claim: Each charge carries its ENTERED IN EVIDENCE receipt naming the real element
items.falsifiedBy: charges rendering with no receipt line beneath them

items.claim: The verdict carries a real docket number, not the JM-LIVE-PREVIEW placeholder
items.falsifiedBy: the placeholder on screen — persistence did not fire, so there is no permalink and no record
